  CAPITAL PROJECTS COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 11, 2026
  130 CHERRY AVE.
  BIXBY PARK SOCIAL HALL, 1:30 PM

Robert Blair, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Gordana Kajer, Commissioner  Jo Murray, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  tamalyn.sayre@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55188  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Tidelands Capital Projects
  Committee meeting of Thursday, March 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55189  Recommendation to receive and file the Tidelands Capital Projects Committee
  report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission Tidelands Capital Projects Committee on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
